acceptance.given: A migrated fixture contains explicit before and after owner-specific authority fields.

oracle.expected: The migration fixture comparison reports owner-specific authority fields unchanged between before and after states.
forbidden: Owner-specific authority fields drift between explicit before and after states.
Validation discards or replaces owner-specific authority fields.
oracle.observable: Migration fixture comparison output during validation

acceptance.then: Validation preserves the owner-specific authority fields.
acceptance.when: During migration-fixture validation, compare the explicit before and after fixture states.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the migration fixture comparison selector and fail when any owner-specific authority field differs or is missing after validation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate migrated fixtures by comparing owner-specific authority fields before and after migration without allowing drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing validation inputs and schemas compatible; rollback only the migration-fixture comparison change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Explicit before and after migrated fixture states are compared; preserved authority fields yield a valid migration result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Migration fixture validation reports success only when every owner-specific authority field is identical before and after.

acceptance.given: An inspected package is provided to the validator.

oracle.expected: A before and after package comparison shows the inspected package bytes and files are unchanged after validation.
forbidden: The validator modifies, rewrites, or persists changes to the inspected package.
Validation changes the package under inspection.
oracle.observable: Filesystem and hash comparison of the inspected package before and after validator execution

acceptance.then: The inspected package remains unchanged after validation.
acceptance.when: Capture package content before validation, run validation, then compare content and metadata after validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the validator immutability test and fail when package files, bytes, or metadata differ after validation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce read-only validation of inspected packages and detect mutation through before and after comparison.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve validator API and package format; rollback only write-prevention and immutability checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package snapshot is captured, validation executes, and post-validation snapshot is compared for equality.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation completes with identical package content and metadata to the pre-validation snapshot.

acceptance.given: A migration fixture or composition check is defined or reported.

oracle.expected: Validation reports identify the artifact as a fixture or composition check and contain no claim that static validation infers arbitrary Skill semantics.
forbidden: The migration fixture or composition check is presented as proof that the static validator can infer arbitrary Skill semantics.
oracle.observable: Validator report classification and semantic-claim text

acceptance.then: The report limits its claim to fixture and composition checking.
acceptance.when: Inspect the generated validation report and its claim metadata during report generation review.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the migration and composition report semantic-claim check and fail if report text or metadata asserts arbitrary Skill-semantic inference.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain migration fixture reporting to fixture and composition evidence and reject unsupported semantic-inference claims.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain report schema compatibility while narrowing claim classification text and metadata.

slice_hint.state_transition: Migration and composition result is classified and emitted with bounded claim language.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every migration and composition report labels fixture or composition checking and contains no arbitrary Skill-semantic inference claim.

acceptance.given: The inspected package has no quality sidecar.

oracle.expected: Validation emits an explicit non-pass outcome that identifies the missing quality sidecar.
forbidden: Validation reports pass solely because the quality sidecar is absent.
The absence of a quality sidecar is silently accepted as a passing result.
oracle.observable: Validation result status and diagnostic for missing quality sidecar

acceptance.then: The absent quality sidecar produces a non-silent, non-pass validation outcome.
acceptance.when: Execute package validation against an input with the quality sidecar removed and inspect status plus diagnostics.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the missing-quality-sidecar validation selector and fail if the validator returns an implicit or silent pass.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an explicit non-pass status and diagnostic when a quality sidecar is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve result schema and existing sidecar-present behavior; rollback only missing-sidecar classification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validator detects absent sidecar and emits an explicit actionable non-pass result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A package without a quality sidecar can never produce a silent or implicit pass.
